birth.segment: Posen and the Line from Worms
birth.stop: Poznań, the birth without a record
birth.date_confidence: reconstruction; no birth record survives. Reference works range from 1512 (Andre Neher, cited in Encyclopedia.com's own bibliography) to about 1526, and the Jewish Encyclopedia says only 'about the second decade of the sixteenth century.' The exhibition Path of Life: Rabbi Judah Loew ben Bezalel, ca. 1525-1609 was held at Prague Castle in 2009 with a 315-page catalogue published by Academia and the Jewish Museum in Prague; the museum's own page credits Alexandr Putík and does not name Olga Sixtová as co-editor. The anniversary of the death fell on 7 September 2009, 18 Elul 5769. A Czech Post stamp was issued in May 2009 and a Czech Mint silver coin in June; a joint Czech and Israeli stamp reproducing his tombstone had appeared separately in April 1997 and is not part of the anniversary programme.
